# Navigation toolbar

The navigation toolbar groups the header controls in a single strip.

## Toolbar layout

Items are ordered from most to least used.

## Keyboard access

Every toolbar item is reachable with the keyboard.

## Navigation toolbar reference

Complete reference for every navigation toolbar control, one entry
per line so agents can cite exact rows.

- Entry 001: control `nav-001` moves focus to the next toolbar group.
- Entry 002: control `nav-002` collapses the overflow section.
- Entry 003: control `nav-003` pins the control to the visible strip.
- Entry 004: control `nav-004` restores the default toolbar order.
- Entry 005: control `nav-005` toggles compact toolbar density.
- Entry 006: control `nav-006` opens the primary navigation menu.
